description: This plot illustrates the BLEU score across different epochs for three data categories: "Regular members," "Members with near-duplicates," and "Held-out data." The x-axis is labeled "Epochs" and features a linear scale with an axis range from 0 to 3.0, displaying tick marks at regular intervals of 0.5. The y-axis is labeled "BLEU score" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 0.35, with tick marks spaced every 0.05. The "Regular members" category is represented by a solid dark blue line without markers. It starts at a BLEU score of approximately 0.015 at x ≈ 0.17, rises gradually with minor fluctuations, and ends at approximately 0.07 at x = 3.0. The "Members with near-duplicates" category is shown as a solid brown line without markers. It begins at approximately 0.025 at x ≈ 0.17, exhibits a steep and steady upward trend to reach about 0.36 at x = 2.5, dips slightly to roughly 0.355 at x ≈ 2.83, and concludes at its highest point of approximately 0.365 at x = 3.0. The "Held-out data" category is depicted by a solid dark green line without markers, starting at approximately 0.025 at x ≈ 0.17, peaking early at roughly 0.04 at x = 0.5, and then remaining relatively flat with slight fluctuations, ending at approximately 0.035 at x = 3.0.
